annotations.title: Data file check and convert: CSV, JSON and Excel

description: Check a CSV, JSON or Excel file before you import it (bad rows, broken emails, duplicates, wrong encoding, mixed types, a score) or convert it between CSV, JSON and .xlsx. Use it when: Before importing a spreadsheet into a CRM, store, database or ad platform; when a user hands over a file you need to understand; or when a tool needs JSON and you have Excel (or the reverse). Not for: PDFs or Word files (use the document reader), old .xls files, or files over 10 MB. Returns: preflight: a verdict, a 0-100 score, every issue with its severity, the column and the Excel row numbers, plus a profile of each column. convert: the converted file (CSV text, JSON records, or an .xlsx file as a data URL). Typical time: about 2 s. Actions: preflight (checks a file the way an importer would and lists everything that will break; needs url or text); convert (converts between csv, json and excel (.xlsx); needs url or text, to). Price: from $0.003 per file, charged only on success. Price depends on action: convert $0.003, preflight $0.003 (default preflight). One call = one file checked or converted (up to 10 MB).

action.description: preflight checks the file; convert turns it into another format

delimiter.description: convert to csv: the separator. Default comma

required_columns.description: preflight: columns that must exist and be filled in every row

sheet.description: Excel sheet name. Default: the first sheet with data

text.description: Or paste the CSV or JSON itself

unique_column.description: preflight: a column whose values must not repeat, e.g. email or sku

url.description: A public link to a CSV, TSV, JSON or .xlsx file (up to 10 MB; Excel up to 5 MB). Google Sheets share links work when the sheet is public
